purpose: Consumer counterexample specifications, not executed assertions or real JEV judgments.

cases.input: A declared design_choice with genuine user Q&A as design basis
cases.expected: Produce its claim_support CheckKey; do not exempt by kind or invent external source

cases.input: A declared claim with no source_ids/evidence links
cases.expected: Still produce its CheckKey; insufficient result blocks under unchanged policy

cases.input: An unrelated source link attached to a declared claim
cases.expected: Still judge semantic support; source existence cannot satisfy claim_support

cases.input: Consumer selects only one of two original revision claims
An applicable required claim_support criterion with an empty revision claim collection
cases.expected: Error; cannot pass or fabricate NA under current method

cases.input: Two exact revision targets each contain claim C1
cases.expected: Keep two target-bound CheckKeys; do not deduplicate by claim_id alone

cases.input: The same exact target/criterion/claim set supplied in different orders
cases.expected: Canonical exact set and plan digest unchanged

cases.input: A substituted ClaimRef statement_digest or owner_revision_ref
Plan has two claim CheckKeys but response answers only one
cases.expected: Reject incomplete answers; no grant from partial review

cases.input: The frozen 2.1.0 MethodRef lacks new binding declarations
cases.expected: Keep historical bytes; no silent upgrade to new all_declared_claims semantics

cases.input: Every per-claim answer is supported and satisfied maps to manual
cases.expected: Preserve manual disposition; not automatic approval
